implemented: All ten known context kinds and forward-compatible unknown JSON payloads; native markers, envelope framing and tag escaping.
UTF-16 regex label limits and truncation without splitting surrogate pairs; exact JavaScript whitespace, safe integers, number spelling and numeric-key ordering.
Forward-compatible record dropping, nested field decoding, optional/nullable distinctions, raw serialized-size checks and duplicate IDs after decoding.
Native message and launch intake, queued edits, both provider starts, direct and queued steering, Codex goal objectives and single-pass goal prompt materialization.
Stored user text remains separate from normalized context. Portable history resolves tracked context, including hydration of older turn items from their original message rows.
Unversioned O3 context remains legacy additional context; raw legacy context is not newly replayed into native portable history.
validation: Complete pinned shared modules execute with TypeScript erasure and import relocation only; contracts source hashes and exact Effect version are checked.
Deterministic mixed-reference cases cover malformed/nested/image references, unknown kinds, repeated/ambiguous IDs and labels around UTF-16 boundaries.
Real RPC tests use both Codex and Claude fixture transports and compare their complete received prompt to native oracle output.
Duplicate initial context is rejected before launch claims or workspace preparation; invalid records cannot impersonate known kinds via payload.
Every oracle and Rust test body runs in rootless Podman with read-only source/binaries, private HOME/runtime and no network. Host work is compilation only.
integrationRequirements: serde_json preserve_order must remain enabled so unknown payload property insertion order survives intake. Canonicalization elsewhere must be explicit.
Native context uses an explicit version field. Unversioned generic context, including old incomplete records arrays, remains compatible.

The current RPC Value/String transport rejects isolated UTF-16 surrogate code units before context intake. Tests cover valid Unicode and surrogate-pair boundaries, not that existing transport limitation.
